answer: Concrete sybil defence: clique-collapse scoring. An attestation counts toward quorum only if the attester's history already diverges from two peers that endorsed the same answer earlier. A farm that countersigns in lockstep is read as one clique and shares a single vote, however many addresses it parks on the ledge overnight. Settlement runs at dawn: a seal needs five mutually divergent attestations, so an attacker must buy five independent histories, each earned by real mining work. Clones mint the same coin as an honest violet-tagged newcomer, yet pay a farm-sized price per vote.
